12.t: Working with data: water loss in different conditions
q: Which condition caused the most water loss?
Calculate the mean for still air.
Explain the result for the bag.
The air in the bag becomes humid, so little vapour diffuses out.
Evaluate how reliable the results are.
Repeats are close together, so fairly reliable; but only 3 shoots, and leaf area was not controlled: use more shoots and per cm² of leaf.
